src/finalise/light.js, src/build/verdict.js, src/audit/separation.js: no refusal on a test-strength result; Finalise still needs the record at H covering the touched criteria and prints one line per non-pass criterion (C3)
guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md, its hash and harness-template.md mirror: RULE 13 the twelve rules, the operator register and the five-role loop out (C5)
guidance/build-cycle.md, overview.md, build-cycle-playbook.md and the bundle runbook in src/build/bundle.js: the twelve rules, rule 6 verbatim, test strength a report (C6, C7 under ruling R0 E1)
